newsitem.title: USA: ONEOK to provide PS Oklahoma transporation.
newsitem.headline: ONEOK to provide PS Oklahoma transporation.

text.p: ONEOK Gas Marketing Co said Tuesday it was the successful bidder for a five-year natural gas transportation and sales agreement with Public Service Co of Oklahoma, a subsidiary of Central and South West Corp.

Under the agreement, the ONEOK Inc subsidiary said, it will provide a firm natural gas supply and transportation to three of PS Oklahoma's six natural gas-fired electric generating plants: the Tulsa Power Station, located in west Tulsa; the Southwestern Power Station, located near Anadarko, Okla.; and the Northeastern Power Station located near Oologah, Okla.
The agreement, which will be effective January 1, 1998, covers most of the firm natural gas requirement for the three stations.
Marketing Director Mark Quinlan said the agreement is a market-sensitive contract with an "innovative pricing structure," which was not discussed in the ONEOK statement.

Terms of the agreement call for natural gas to be transported by ONG Transmission Co, which plans to start construction on additional pipelines to serve the three generating plants. ((-- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.))
